properties.description:
Implemented and verified, awaiting human review.

Better Auth 1.7.6 now owns local browser sign-in and sessions, backed by Node 24's built-in SQLite driver. The machine-local auth store is excluded from versioned buildspace artifacts. Launcher links are single-use and valid for two minutes; the browser receives a host-only HttpOnly cookie with a 30-day absolute lifetime. Task URLs remain credential-free. Separate tool sessions, central Host/Origin checks and distinct managed-preview hosts protect the local HTTP boundary. Expired/revoked/invalid sessions are rejected. Old 127.0.0.1 bookmarks redirect to localhost without losing the selected task.

Verified the original failure before editing, then passed the same exact create/update-link scenario after all authenticated tabs close. Automated coverage also passes browser/server restart, preview isolation, session expiry/revocation and launcher reuse. In the actual Codex browser, closed every app tab, confirmed zero remaining tabs, reopened the tool-returned design-task link and verified the exact task loaded. The live session also survived the app restart and old-URL redirect.

Final npm run test:all: 135 backend tests and 108 browser tests passed. Lifecycle regressions cover asynchronous authentication during shutdown and unused browser preconnections. The checkpoint also exposed a queue-navigation race; a controlled reproduction and fix ensure delayed queue/trigger responses cannot override a newer navigation.

Evidence attached: implementation/verification report, exact before/expected/after results, reopened task screenshot, queue-navigation reproduction/fix logs and final full checkpoint log.

Scope: local browser/API transport, not per-person/buildspace authorization, workspace encryption or an OS sandbox. Separate MCP transport authentication remains unchanged. Changes remain uncommitted; the parent MVP review is still awaiting the user's review and has not been accepted.
properties.title: Preserve browser sign-in when reopening planning tool links
